steps.text: The Sun is our main source of heat, but different regions feel it differently. Let's compare.
Tap a region to see its temperature — try a coastal one and an inland one.
Places near the sea are milder — the sea warms up and cools down slowly, so it evens out the temperature.
Inland places, far from the sea, get hotter days and colder nights. Proximity to the sea is a big reason regions differ.

coach.mission: Compare how coastal and inland regions differ in temperature.
whenStuck: Tap different regions and compare their temperatures.
Look at which ones are near the sea.
whenWrong: Coastal areas are milder; inland areas swing hotter and colder.
The sea moderates temperature, so nearby places are more even.
whenCorrect: Right — being near the sea keeps a region's temperature milder.
Good — inland regions have bigger temperature swings.
coach.done: You've seen why regions differ in temperature. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
